identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.02] Govern Layer 8 identity, authority, refusal, and audit

values.task_boundary: Prepare and later implement only issue #112 Runtime authority, refusal, replay, redacted audit, and narrow pre-delivery API integration over the exact merged gated contracts.
deliverables: Canonical issue identity/title: [v0.92][WP-18C.02a][112.a] Define shared Layer 8 signed authority core
Signed identity-message contract with credential-generation binding
Focused adversarial and direct exchange tests
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Stable principals derive only from authenticated, unexpired, non-revoked runtime identity evidence with current credential generation.
AC-2: Core authority decisions require least-privilege capability, current agent policy, and current Polis policy intersection before a grant is returned.

AC-3: Expiry, rotation or stale generation, revocation, stale capability epoch, policy unavailability, malformed input, replay ambiguity, invalid signatures, non-canonical payloads, and audit failure fail closed.
AC-4: Recipient substitution, recipient-set widening, implicit broadcast, action or conversation scope escalation, replay, and cross-Polis attempts are rejected by the core before a grant.

AC-5: Public refusals and audit records expose only bounded decision, refusal, correlation, principal, recipient, conversation, and outcome fields and omit secrets, private cognition, raw provider payloads, private signing keys, and message content.
AC-6: Restart restores replay and redacted audit integrity before core admission; corrupt, truncated, reordered, discontinuous, or unwritable audit state remains unavailable.

AC-7: Human-agent and direct agent-agent requests share one canonical signed identity-message contract with externally held per-principal keys, credential-generation binding, and exact recipient binding.

AC-8: Recipient acknowledgement verification primitives bind sender, recipient, conversation, correlation, causation, replay identity, expiry, and triggering message; signature substitution, stale rotation, revocation, and expiry fail closed.
AC-9: Focused runtime-kernel authority-core tests, formatting, clippy, and diff hygiene pass at the exact implementation revision with nonzero test selection.
dependencies: Hard serial gate: #111 must be closed by a merged PR and ancestral to the execution base
repo_inputs: Merged #111 conversation contract once terminal and ancestral
non_goals: Implementing or mutating either gated issue, the umbrella issue, or any sibling work package
Canonical session schemas, durable history or search, rooms, roster or presence, attention inbox, or final product hardening
Constitutional governance, TLS, ACIP, identity, provider, transport, or general control redesign
Browser-owned authorization, unrestricted operator actuation, private-policy exposure, or retention of forbidden content
Product implementation, binding, push, PR, publication, merge, GitHub mutation, or closeout during this preparation run
